copies.my-chrome: Sidebar header. Keeps the 76px traffic-light gap only while mine.json keeps the window buttons on screen.
copies.my-status: Status bar. Records the last 50 focused panes for pane-jump (alt-tab), and shows the space chip while the sidebar is hidden. Also shows the update-check pill. A 'manual' link opens herdr-app/manual.html in atlas.
copies.my-tabs: Tab bar. A zoomed tab shows an accent expand icon instead of a trailing Z.
copies.my-pane: Pane header. A zoomed pane shows 'N hidden' with an expand icon on the right. Also shows the pane's letter while cmd-m picks.
copies.layout:mine: The window. Uses the copies above, puts space-chip left of the tabs, moves the traffic lights off screen.

own.space-chip: Shown space's avatar and name left of the tabs while the sidebar is hidden.
own.setup-check: Opens a Claude tab that runs custom/CHECK.md. Opened from the status-bar pill or the update toast.
own.go-space-1..9: alt-N / ctrl-N: Nth space that is not a worktree.
own.pane-jump: alt-tab, held: the 9 most recent panes, previous one selected. Tab and ` move, 1-9 jump, letting go of alt goes. keys.json mod:pane-jump sends those keys to it while open. Reads shared pane.recent written by my-status.
own.pane-copy: alt-shift-c: copies the focused terminal id with pbcopy.
own.pane-pick: cmd-m: WezTerm-style pane select. Letters show in each pane's header (my-pane reads shared pane.pick).
own.tab-jump: cmd-alt-k and cmd-shift-k (both while choosing): tabs of the shown space. Number keys go, / filters.
own.atlas-chip: Status-bar chip for the focused agent's atlas repo: doing, done today, docs. Owns the atlas data (shared "atlas"). Design: atlas/repos/herdr/herdr-app/atlas-mod/design.html Finds session docs with docs.sh. Commands: atlas-chip.open (cmd-shift-a), atlas-chip.scope.
own.atlas-pop: The atlas chip's hover popup: Doing and the top 3 of Next, with start and done. Reads shared "atlas".
own.atlas-panel: The atlas page of the right panel (child of panel-body): timeline of Doing, Next, Done (20 a page) and this session's docs. cmd-shift-a runs atlas-chip.open.

keys: keys.json is ours, so new default bindings from an update don't arrive by themselves. Compare against AGENTS.md's key section and herdr-app commands.
